rules.expr: (100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total[5m])) / (count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total)))) > __CPU_READY_WARN__
